{{Attr|Corpse}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Cleats''' was a speedy enemy from the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It has faster speed and health than the [[Soccer Ball]] that appeared before it. ==Appearance== The '''Cleats''' are light blue and yellow shoes. They have "''PREDATOR''" written on their side. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CleatsCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CleatsIconIG.png|'''Cleats''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Cleats''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Cleats''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Cleats's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Cleats''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BackyardBeginnings|Start|N/A|[[Soccer Ball]] & Cleats|Wave 1|[[Boombox]]|Wave 3}} {{CompetitionCourt|Start|N/A|[[Soccer Ball]] & Cleats|Wave 1|[[Boombox]]|Wave 3}} {{VictoryField|[[Soccer Ball]]|Wave 1 (Easy)|hardt1 = Start|hardw1 = N/A (Hard)|Cleats|Wave 2 (Easy)|hardt2 = [[Soccer Ball]] & Cleats|hardw2 = Wave 1 (Hard)|[[Boombox]]|Wave 3}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
